environment.mode: isolated temporary Git repository with ignored deployment environment

dirtyTrackedCheckout.blocker: Deployment preflight requires a clean Git checkout.

mismatchedReleaseSha.blocker: RELAY_RELEASE_SHA does not match git rev-parse HEAD for this checkout.

invariant: A deployment cannot pass preflight unless RELAY_RELEASE_SHA is the exact HEAD of a clean Git checkout.
boundary: This is deterministic preflight logic evidence in an isolated local repository. It does not prove public DNS, Docker, Caddy, deployed certificates or actual ChatGPT execution.
